permit.applies: The employer applies to the Department of Employment for a work permit for a specific post before the work begins, after registering the vacancy; the Notice of Terms of Engagement may not start before the permit is issued.
permit.first: A Notification of Vacancy registered with the Department of Employment before seeking to engage the worker.

fees.what: Application for a Work Permit (as at 1 August 2026)
Renewal of a Work Permit (as at 1 August 2026)
Notification of Vacancy, per position (as at 1 August 2026; employers with 10 employees or fewer exempt)

permit.pay: Remuneration cannot be less than the Minimum Wage set in the Conditions of Employment (Standard Minimum Wage) Order.

sources.title: HM Government of Gibraltar, Department of Employment: Employment Service Registration Explained
sources.said: Persons who are not entitled to work in Gibraltar (e.g. non-EEA nationals, see notes below) will require an employer to request a Work Permit before commencement of employment. A work permit is issued to an employer for a specific post and for a period not exceeding 12 months. … Notice of Terms of Engagement (The start date on the Terms of Engagement CANNOT be prior to the date of issue of the Work Permit) … If a work permit is due to expire an application to renew must be completed before 14 days of expiry. … A Notification of Vacancy form must be completed and ALL vacancies must be registered with the Department of Employment before seeking to engage a person as a worker. … Remuneration CANNOT be less that the Minimum Wage as set out in the Conditions of Employment (Standard Minimum Wage) Order.

sources.title: HM Government of Gibraltar, Department of Employment: Table of Fees (Employment Regulations, 1994), current and as at 1 August 2026
sources.said: Employment Regulations, 1994 Current Fee As at 1 August 2026 Notification of Vacancy made in accordance with Regulation 4(1) (per position)* £9.50 £10.00 … Application for a Work Permit £68.50 £70.00 Renewal of a Work Permit £35.00 £36.00

sources.said: Vacancies must be registered with the Department of … Employment at least 10 days prior to the … commencement date of that worker.
